Vehicles.VehicleBuildDef.label: T-55
Vehicles.VehicleBuildDef.description:
A main battle tank fighting vehicle, the T-55 is a tank with a lot of modification potential. Decent cargo capacity along with four crew capacity. All-around armor effective against high caliber rounds and close-blast shell fragments, armed with a 100mm D-10T cannon turret coupled with a top-mounted turret that both can fire either mobile or stationary.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Gunner x2, Passenger x1
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel
